remarks: Expanded, fully furnished turnkey corner Villa in the desirable Oasis Resort in South Palm Springs, where short-term rentals are allowed and in demand. This single-story 2BD/2BA unit offers rare privacy with no neighbors above or below. Features include a 1-car garage and two spacious, private patios, front and rear, ideal for seamless indoor-outdoor living and entertaining. The south-facing rear patio brings in abundant natural light, enhancing the open living spaces. Set within beautifully maintained Spanish Villa-style grounds, the community offers lush landscaping with mature palms, fruit trees, jacaranda, colorful bougainvillea, and tranquil fountains throughout.
